artemis_budget_inputs.hdd_basis: Existing model drive allowances $1150/$950/$850 in 1980/81/82 plus $150/$100/$100 enclosure, supply, interface and cabling. Early 5 MB subsystem may use an external enclosure; exact OEM remains an engineering qualification assumption. Two floppies retained.

pricing.balance_formula: Retail = sqrt(recurring_cost * comparable_price / (1-dealer_fee)). Equalises contribution/net-revenue and discount/comparable-price. 1980–81 have no verified comparable basket: use 25% net contribution fallback. 1982 IBM baskets are reference assumptions, with substitute OS qualification in this story.

artemis_budget_inputs.software_timing: Business Tools and AIONix from May 1980; Abacus 3 added only from November 19 1980. No early native Abacus 2, compatibility card, mouse, networking or later graphics implied. Budget systems retain 16 KiB video and Color II 640x200; network included from May 1981 as in the existing base bundle.

ncc_1982_inputs.basis: Engineering planning estimates, not supplier quotes. Recurring unit costs exclude R&D, masks, tooling, capital, marketing and dealer commission. BOM remains an unqualified design baseline.
ncc_1982_inputs.process: Existing qualified 3 um logic and cheapest dated qualified AION 4164 recipe. Do not assume July 2 um RAM is available on June 15.

comparators.policy: No verified same-date like-for-like comparator for the new dual-roller mouse, custom displays or cards. Use existing 25% net-contribution cost-based fallback, not a fabricated balanced discount.
excluded_anchors: NEC domestic retail price is not an OEM assembly quote or normalized US equivalent.
Later-1982 mouse ads and later VGA products cannot establish June 15 equivalent prices.

comdex_1982_cost_inputs.basis: Provisional nominal USD engineering estimates for accepted November revision. Unchanged component/labor/energy/RAM rates explicitly carried forward from June 15; no claimed November vendor quotes. Capital, design/mask NRE and marketing excluded.
comdex_1982_cost_inputs.graphics_area_basis: 100 mm2 June line/blit controller plus 12 mm2 planning allowance for inherited mode/sprite/palette compatibility; retain 3 um, .72 new-part maturity and existing package assumption. Not measured silicon area.
comdex_1982_cost_inputs.monitor_basis: $230 analog HD17H-class OEM core includes its linear amplifier (June core allowance was $210); $9 covers intensity DAC and level matching, replacing the $20 separate amplifier/DAC allowance. Existing $25 deflection adaptation remains, with qualification pending; no duplicate amplifier charge.
comdex_1982_cost_inputs.routing: Professional card 1.5 h, 2.2 kWh, $1.75 baseline consumables; monitor 2.5 h, 9 kWh, $3 baseline consumables. Common model applies its 1982 overhead factor to consumables. No prior-year assembly learning on either revision.
comdex_1982_cost_inputs.autocad_price_basis: Historical original US list price $1000; scenario Artemis licence planning anchor, not a negotiated contract. Vendor costs and channel split unspecified.

memory_manufacturing.financial_horizon: Recurring prices/costs through June 1981; industrial cash and ROI through 1981 Q4. Later recipe economics and budgets are prospective; no invented 1982–83 company sales.

pilot_operations.basis: Dedicated development line. 60 pilot wafers/quarter plus utilities, service and consumables; programme engineering payroll separate. No pilot saleable output credited.
